description:
Garry Newman says Facepunch got S&Box wrong. The would-be successor to Garry's Mod is losing money, struggling to keep players and rebuilding the ideas it launched with. From the sausage people to a storefront drowning in slop, we look at what went wrong and whether a fairer alternative to Roblox can still work.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
